description: This file defines the 'OpenmrsMetadata' interface within the OpenMRS project, which is used to represent metadata objects that are system or descriptive data in the OpenMRS data model. The interface extends 'Auditable' and 'Retireable', and declares methods for getting and setting metadata properties such as name, description, and change tracking details, with deprecation notes indicating changes in mutability behavior in newer versions.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the metadata item.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the metadata item.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the metadata item.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the metadata item.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who changed this metadata, deprecated since version 2.2.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who changed this metadata, deprecated since version 2.2.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the date when this metadata was changed, deprecated since version 2.2.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the date when this metadata was changed, deprecated since version 2.2.
